studies.title: Al-Idrisi's world map
studies.caption: At the court of Roger II of Sicily, al-Idrisi combines Arabic geography with the reports of travellers questioned at the port into seventy sectional maps and a silver planisphere.
studies.prompt: Over-shoulder scene at Palermo in1154CE: a geographer compares hand-drawn sectional maps and traveller notes on a low worktable, one large circular silver map disk partly visible at side. South-oriented medieval mapping rather than modern Mercator continents, no fantasy throne scene or printed atlas.
